topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I just found out that the surprise party for me this weekend isn't happening after all. It’s strange, things felt off when I saw how everyone was acting, too quiet, too distant. I keep thinking about all the plans they made, the effort they put in, and now it’s all for nothing. I hope everything is alright with everyone. It’s hard not to worry about what’s really going on, especially when something like this gets cancelled out of the blue.
